inputs.text: SSANU has given the federal government one month to complete renegotiations of the 2009 agreement with non-teaching university unions, or face an indefinite nationwide strike. Workers should not have to threaten a shutdown to make institutions honor commitments they have left unresolved for years. Universities depend on non-teaching staff, yet their labor and livelihoods are too easily treated as secondary. The government needs to negotiate seriously and deliver fair treatment—not wait for workers to withdraw their labor before listening.
